question: Most Harappan seals made of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Steatite**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Thousands of seals have been discovered by archaeologists from the Harappan sites.
 
• Most of the seals were made of steatite which is a kind of soft stone.
